cues.title: Begin with a useful bound hit
cues.body: 2A6 anchors its purine core in the CDK2 hinge and presents a phenyl edge toward an open pocket. That experimental pose is the structural starting point.

cues.title: The designer chooses where to grow
cues.body: Select carbon C19 as the meta exit vector. That persistent atom identity removes the ring symmetry ambiguity before any pose search begins.
cues.detail: Agent API · session.inspect → attachmentAtomId for C19

cues.title: Grow the first analogue
cues.body: designRoute.applyStep preserves the selected attachment while the graph changes from H to Cl. Pose refinement keeps the inherited hinge-binding core in place.
cues.detail: Agent API · applyStep({ stepId, attachmentAtomId }) → pose.refine → pose.apply

cues.title: The first growth vector lands
cues.body: First the frozen purple prediction is shown alone. Then the post-freeze 1H1R crystal replaces it in the identical frame: the chlorine lands on the same side of the ring without an obscuring overlay.
cues.detail: Agent API sequence 12 freeze → 1H1R opened after freeze · edited group RMSD 0.53 Å · whole ligand RMSD 1.06 Å

cues.title: Carry the predicted pose forward
cues.body: The first Agent API prediction becomes the structural reference for the next design step. The trajectory is continuous from the original hit.
cues.detail: pose.captureReference · predicted 6CP becomes the next starting state

cues.title: Use the same designer-controlled exit vector
cues.body: C19 remains a persistent atom in predicted 6CP. Selecting it again directs the chlorine-to-sulfonamide transformation into the intended pocket volume.
cues.detail: Agent API · C19 attachmentAtomId preserved across the predicted intermediate

cues.title: Grow the lead-like polar group
cues.body: The second graph edit replaces chlorine with sulfonamide. The predicted group expands into the selected pocket region while the hit-derived core remains anchored.
cues.detail: Agent API · second applyStep → 64-candidate refinement → frozen N76 prediction

cues.title: The second bound pose is reproduced
cues.body: The frozen purple N76 prediction is replaced by the post-freeze 1OIU crystal without moving the camera or receptor. The complete ligand pose is reproduced; no double molecule is needed to make the result legible.
cues.detail: Agent API sequence 22 freeze → 1OIU opened after freeze · whole ligand RMSD 0.85 Å · edited group RMSD 1.83 Å

cues.title: One hit pose supports two design steps
cues.body: Explicit designer intent turns a graph edit into a spatial design action. The Agent API carries the 1H1Q pose through chlorine growth and onward to the sulfonamide bound pose.
